abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. The condition was REF_PITCH_IS, which tests a REFERENCED card's pitch VALUE -- there is no referenced card here. 'A yellow card in your pitch zone' is a zone count.

_comment:
Implementation copied verbatim from blistering_assault_blue, whose printed functional text is identical to this card's once each card's own name is substituted out. Everything that differs between them -- cost, pitch, power, colour -- comes from the card DB, not from this file, so the DSL is the same card twice.

THE COPY IS PINNED, not trusted: tests/test_copied_card_implementations.py asserts that these abilities still match blistering_assault_blue's and that the two printed texts still agree, so a later edit to one cannot silently leave the other behind. That is the insult_to_injury failure -- three printings of one sentence with three different implementations, the blue one missing a gate the others had.
